annotations.title: Observed versions of one filing within your plan window

description: Observed versions of one disclosure within the caller’s filing window, oldest first. The change stream is append-only, so an amendment supersedes rather than overwrites. Both versions of a restatement may appear here, each with its own change block and receipt.url. restated=true means content changed after first publication; each version records what changed and when. See https://www.veridionmarkets.com/api/v1/openapi.json for full response fields. The version field is the MCP connector release (1.22.0), not the REST API release.

disclosure_id.description: Permanent disclosure_id from search_disclosures. Identifiers survive restatement and are never reused.
